events.title: SPYAIR
description: SPYAIR are a Japanese rock band from Nagoya, together since 2005 and signed to Sony Music. They're best known for anime themes, including Haikyū!!, Gintama, Bleach and Gundam, and have played Tokyo's Nippon Budokan.
A huge thanks to JNIGHT and Aura Productions who allowed me to be part of this, a milestone I'll remember in my career, here's to many many more.

events.title: Camilla PNK
description: Camilla PNK is a guitarist and DJ/producer who plays live guitar over her own DJ sets. I got to photograph her show thanks to JNIGHT, and it pushed me towards a looser, more experimental style, with motion blur and light trails, that I'd like to explore further.

events.title: SYNSNAKE
description: SYNSNAKE are a South Korean band from Seoul, together since 2015, mixing K-pop aesthetics with a metalcore sound.

These photos were taken during the collaboration between JNIGHT and AuraProductions at Circolo Magnolia, for the Man With A Mission concert. Special thanks to Circolo Magnolia and AuraProductions for making this possible.

events.title: GRIMM GRIMM
description: GRIMM GRIMM is the project of Tokyo-born, London-based songwriter and producer Koichi Yamanoha, with albums on ATP Recordings and collaborations with artists like Lætitia Sadier and Bo Ningen.

These photos were taken during the collaboration between JNIGHT and AuraProductions at Circolo Magnolia, for the Man With A Mission concert. Special thanks to Circolo Magnolia and AuraProductions for making this possible.

events.title: CLOUDIAN
description: CLOUDIAN are a South Korean rock band with an epic, cinematic sound, and have already toured across Europe.

These photos were taken during the collaboration between JNIGHT and AuraProductions at Circolo Magnolia, for the Man With A Mission concert. Special thanks to Circolo Magnolia and AuraProductions for making this possible.

events.title: JNIGHT
description: Photo coverage of the events, documenting their key moments with a focus on the quality of the content.
Support with the technical and logistic organisation, setting up the venue and solving technical issues before and during the events.

events.title: Live
description: Over the years I've been to many live music events, photographing the artists while they perform on stage.

events.title: IVISIONATICI
